# a11y-audit

On-demand reference adapted from the vendored MIT UI/UX Kit. Project policy
and frontend-design govern scope and completion.

Check the changed controls against relevant WCAG criteria: semantic name/role,
keyboard operation, visible/unobscured focus, contrast, reflow, target size,
and accessible authentication. Use ../accessibility/aria-patterns.md and
../accessibility/wcag-checklist.md for patterns. Inspect real states and measure
changed color pairs. Report criteria, evidence, and concrete fixes. Empty or
skipped scans remain unverified.
